Responsável por auxiliar o gerente de boutique em todas as tarefas administrativas respeitando a abordagem e estratégia empresarial para atingir objetivos de desempenho definidos em termos de vendas, bem como os objetivos qualitativos, incluindo a qualidade do serviço e aparência da boutique de acordo com a estratégia e política da Swarovski.

Sobre o cargo

Você é defensor(a) da nossa marca. Nesta função, e juntamente com a equipa, irá:

  • Realizar as tarefas de Contabilidade, emissão de NF série 01e D1 e enviar os documentos fiscais ao escritório/ Pryor (NF´s , leitura X e leitura z) a fim de garantir o funcionamento dos procedimentos fiscais na boutique.
  • Realizar as tarefas de TI, solicitar manutenção de equipamento ou suporte do sistema quando necessário.
  • Realizar as tarefas de RH, envio de escala de folgas e folha de ponto ao escritório
  • Informar através do email e fax, a chegada de boletos bancários na boutique, e enviar posteriormente ao setor de contas as pagar.
  • Outras tarefas de rotina da área

Sobre você

Você é Um(a) Pessoa De Caixa Excecional, Que Nos Oferece

  • um excelente sentido de moda e uma verdadeira paixão pela nossa marca e os nossos produtos;
  • experiência/forte interesse nas marcas de moda/cosmética/estilo de vida de luxo;
  • uma personalidade fortemente motivada e focada na orientação do cliente;
  • dedicação e atitude orientada por objetivos;
  • vontade de desenvolver a sua carreira e crescer conosco

O que oferecemos

Você pode esperar uma série de benefícios, incluindo:

  • Descontos em produtos Swarovski
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário
  • Licença para voluntario
  • Programas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento

Sobre a Swarovski

A Swarovski produz produtos à base de cristal de qualidade e habilidade artística impecáveis que trazem alegria e celebram a individualidade. Fundada em 1895 na Áustria, a empresa desenha, fabrica e vende sofisticados cristais, pedras preciosas, diamantes e zircônias fabricadas e acessórios, bem como objetos de cristal e acessórios para a casa. A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Junto com suas empresas irmãs, a Swarovski Optik (dispositivos ópticos) e a Tyrolit (abrasivos), a Swarovski Crystal Business compõe o Swarovski Group. Uma relação saudável com as pessoas e com o planeta é parte da herança da Swarovski. Hoje, esse legado se fundamenta em medidas de sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor, com ênfase na inovação circular, defendendo a diversidade, inclusão e autoexpressão, e no trabalho filantrópico da Swarovski Foundation, que apoia organizações de caridade que provocam um impacto ambiental e social positivo.

Swarovski é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades. Oferemos à nossa equipe a coragem de celebrar a individualidade e o orgulho de criar um local de trabalho onde as pessoas se sintam envolvidas, respeitadas, valorizadas, conectadas e ouvidas. Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. Todos os aspectos do emprego, incluindo a decisão de contratar, promover, disciplinar ou demitir, serão baseados no mérito, competência, desempenho e necessidades do negócio. Não discriminamos com base em raça, cor, religião, estado civil, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência física ou mental, condição médica, gravidez, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei nos países onde operamos.

description:
A Unimed Campinas acredita no poder da diversidade para juntos conectarmos experiências, promovendo a troca e fazermos a diferença no propósito de cuidar das pessoas! Por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, etc. Todos são bem vindos!!

Quer fazer parte? Então confira a oportunidade abaixo!

O que buscamos:

Psicólogo (a) responsável por realizar atendimentos clínicos, avaliando e acompanhando o desenvolvimento emocional e social dos pacientes, emitindo diagnósticos, relatórios e orientações, além de atuar em equipe interdisciplinar para garantir a qualidade e continuidade do tratamento conforme as normativas vigentes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atendimento psicológico, avaliando o desenvolvimento emocional e os processos mentais e sociais dos pacientes.

  • Diagnosticar hipóteses sobre distúrbios emocionais, mentais e de adaptação social, esclarecendo conflitos durante o processo terapêutico.
  • Atender e orientar familiares para facilitar a reabilitação, recuperação ou aprendizado dos pacientes.
  • Emitir relatórios sobre a evolução do paciente para escolas, médicos e outros profissionais.
  • Referenciar e contra referenciar informações relevantes sobre o paciente ao médico assistente ou outro profissional envolvido no acompanhamento.
  • Participar de reuniões interdisciplinares, discutindo casos e definindo condutas para continuidade do tratamento.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores operacionais e estratégicos para aprimorar continuamente a prestação de serviço.
  • Registrar atendimentos e exames no prontuário eletrônico, garantindo a qualidade e sigilo das informações.
  • Seguir as normativas da ANS/DUT (referentes ao CID e número de sessões).
  • Fornecer relatórios e documentos solicitados pelo Núcleo de Regulação Não Médica, alinhando as condutas conforme as DUTs.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Psicologia e CRP ativo
  • Experiência prévia na área de psicoterapia e atendimento psicológico.
  • Conhecimento em normativas da ANS/DUT e CID.
  • Pós Graduação em Neuropsicologia.

Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high‑code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning. We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak. With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Human Resources Services

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Toradex is a leading provider of embedded computing solutions, specializing in powerful, reliable, and easy-to-use hardware and software for IoT , industrial automation, medical devices, and other verticals. With a focus on high-quality, reliability, ease-of-use, and a strong developer experience, Toradex offers a range of System on Modules (SoMs), accompanying accessories and carrier boards, customization services, a full-stack software offering facilitating cyber regulations compliance, and much more. Headquartered in Switzerland, with offices across the globe, Toradex is committed to empowering developers and businesses by delivering innovative, high-quality solutions that reduce complexity and accelerate time to market.

Job Description

As a Product Marketing Manager at Toradex, you will play a key role in shaping how the market perceives our cutting-edge embedded computing solutions. You’ll lead initiatives to build awareness and drive adoption by combining strategic product positioning with creative storytelling. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Design, you will help to execute go-to-market strategies, craft clear and differentiated messaging, and collaborate to translate complex technical capabilities into compelling narratives and impactful campaigns. This role blends analytical thinking and creative vision, requiring the ability to connect engineering depth with market relevance, as well as the skill to develop high-performing content that drives awareness, engagement, and growth across multiple channels.

Goals

Drive awareness and accelerate adoption of Toradex products by shaping market perception, building strong narratives, and ensuring consistent, impactful communication across all touchpoints, from technical storytelling to creative execution.

How

  • Efficiently sharing positioning and messaging for new Toradex products and aligning the company and customers around that.
  • Creating narratives that communicate the value and differentiation of our products to developers, engineers, and decision-makers.
  • Partnering closely with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation and Design to translate technical capabilities into compelling stories.
  • Ensuring messaging consistency across website, campaigns, events, and collateral.
  • Monitoring and analyzing marketing performance to continuously refine both positioning and creative execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Positioning & Messaging: Helping to create a clear and differentiated product story that resonates with target audiences and aligns internal teams on the “why” behind our products.
  • Content Creation: Act as aCreative Strategist, translating product messaging into creative concepts and storytelling frameworks. Create copy for key assets such as product pages, digital ads, launch materials, presentations, blogs, and videos to drive awareness of new products and features across different audiences and channels.
  • Go-to-Market Support: Collaborate on product launches by defining messaging frameworks, coordinating enablement materials, and ensuring cross-team alignment.
  • Campaign Collaboration: Partner with Paid Media, Social, Product Marketing, and Designteams to align messaging, visuals, and campaign objectives and to ensure campaigns accurately reflect product positioning and market insights.
  • Market Feedback Loop: Gather insights from campaigns and customers to refine messaging and guide content priorities.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Product, Sales, and Demand Generation to ensure GTM alignment and consistency across regions and verticals.

Desired Candidate Profile

Must Have:

  • Between 3 to 5 years of professional experience in Product Marketing, Marketing Management, or Creative Strategy within a technology or B2B context
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a proven background working with technical products
  • Strong English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Understanding of B2B technology marketing in global markets
  • Proven ability to create content for both technical and business audiences
  • Experience crafting ad copy, creative concepts, and performance-driven campaigns for both awareness and lead generation
  • Understands paid marketing and social media dynamics, and how to adapt creative to maximize reach and engagement across platforms
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to measure and iterate on marketing effectiveness
  • Collaborative working style, comfortable coordinating across multiple teams and functions
  • Passionate and enthusiastic about talking about new, cutting-edge technology devices
  • Proven ability to lead by influence

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in Toradex’s target verticals such as Healthcare, Industrial Automation, Transportation, Smart City, or Test & Measurement
  • Familiarity with Embedded Systems or related hardware/software technologies

What we offer

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

description:
Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE)

Join to apply for the Critical Environment Field Service Engineer (CEFSE) role at Microsoft Power Platform Community

Business Function Overview

In alignment with Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. As a CO+I CE Field Service Engineer, you will deliver core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Responsibilities

  • Ensures compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
  • Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
  • Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
  • Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.
  • Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters.
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year.
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives.
  • Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters.
  • Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed.
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring.
  • Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs).
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio.
  • Hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service).
  • Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent AND 2+ year(s) industry experience in a datacenter or other critical environment facility.
  • OR 3+ years industry experience and college course work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services.
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects.
  • Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.).

Background Check Requirements

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We Offer:

  • Attendance bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*

  • Discounts on Ambev products*

CHC Navigation is a global provider of innovative GNSS navigation and positioning solutions covering a wide range of professional applications, including land and airborne surveys, conventional GNSS surveys, 3D mass data acquisition, precision farming, unmanned navigation and robotics, real-time GNSS infrastructure, and more.

CHC Navigation is now seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Marketing specialist to join our team. This role is designed for a local professional who can drive regional marketing initiatives, enhance brand visibility, and support our growth in the Brazilian markets.

About the Role

In this dynamic role, you will be responsible for developing and executing localized promotion strategies to strengthen CHC Navigation’s brand presence in Brazil. You will collaborate closely with regional sales teams, agents, and global marketing to create impactful campaigns, produce compelling content, and engage key stakeholders across the region.

  • Conduct market and product research to understand customer needs, competitive landscape, and regional trends, and develop tailored marketing promotion strategies.

  • Empower and support local distributors and agents with promotional materials, training, and customized marketing needs.
  • Build and maintain relationships with KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) and KOCs (Key Opinion Customers), and establish a local promotion resource library.

About You

  • Location & Eligibility: Brazilian local candidate, based in Brazil and legally eligible to work in the country.
  • Language Requirements: Professional working proficiency in English or Chinese (written and spoken).

  • Experience: 1-3 years of experience in marketing, promotion, or content creation, preferably in technology, machinery, or B2B industries. Experience with regional campaign execution is an advantage.
  • Content Production Skills: Ability to independently plan, shoot, and edit high-quality promotional videos using modern tools/software.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication and relationship‑building skills to engage with customers, partners, and internal teams effectively.
  • Travel Readiness: Willingness and ability to undertake frequent regional travel as required for events, customer visits, and promotional activities.

Travel Requirements

This role involves regular travel within Brazil and occasionally across Latin America to support exhibitions, customer engagements, agent training, and field marketing activities. Travel frequency will align with campaign schedules and business needs.

What We Offer

  • A key role in a global innovative company where you can shape regional marketing strategies and directly impact brand growth in Latin America.
  • Opportunity to work in a multicultural, collaborative environment with a passionate team.
  • Professional development and training in global marketing practices and advanced GNSS technology.
  • Competitive compensation package, including performance-based incentives.

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial

  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

Descrição da vaga: A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália. Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Procuramos um(a) Analista de Mercado/ BI JR para atuar no monitoramento e análise do mercado de tripas naturais bovinas. A posição integra a área de Business Intelligence da companhia, que é responsável pelas demandas de inteligência de mercado e, portanto, pela geração de análises e insights que orientam as decisões comerciais e estratégicas dos negócios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Acompanhar preços, fluxos de exportação e importação, volumes e players do mercado, bem como dos mercados que utilizam tripas naturais como matéria-prima;
  • Fazer projeções de preços;
  • Monitorar indicadores econômicos e geopolíticos que impactam o negócio;
  • Pesquisar, tratar, estruturar e analisar bases de dados, tanto internos quanto de fontes externas (tais como consultorias de dados, sites oficiais dos países, associações representativas de setores etc.), utilizando Excel, Power BI, SQL e Python;
  • Mapear tendências e dados do mercado, contextualizá-los e apresentá-los em PowerPoint nas reuniões com o time comercial;
  • Criar relatórios e dashboards para apoio às decisões comerciais;
  • Conduzir as reuniões semanais com o time comercial para discussões sobre mercado, preços, volume e posicionamento de mercado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Comércio Exterior, Engenharia(s) ou áreas correlatas.

  • Local: Campinas/SP – Presencial.
  • Área: Inteligência de Mercado / BI.

Sobre a Minerva Foods

Líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul, a Minerva Foods é mais do que uma empresa global – somos uma comunidade de profissionais com o propósito de seguir “criando conexões entre pessoas, alimentos e natureza”. Atuamos em mais de 100 países, e contamos com unidades no Brasil, Paraguai, Argentina, Uruguai, Colômbia e plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália e no Chile. Com uma gestão sólida e estratégias inovadoras, buscamos constantemente os mercados mais promissores, modernizando nossas operações e oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade. Nossa logística integrada e diversificação geográfica garantem soluções que atendem às mais rigorosas demandas globais. Na Minerva Foods, sustentabilidade não é apenas um compromisso – é parte do nosso DNA. Adotamos práticas responsáveis que promovem a preservação ambiental, o bem-estar animal e a transparência em toda a cadeia de produção. Com iniciativas robustas de rastreabilidade, contribuímos para um futuro mais sustentável e transparente. Nosso impacto global é sustentado por 46 unidades industriais, 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Esses pilares nos permitem entregar produtos saudáveis e nutritivos para clientes em todo o mundo. Se você compartilha valores como Orientação para Resultados, Comprometimento, Sustentabilidade, Inovação e Reconhecimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente que incentiva a excelência, promove o desenvolvimento e cria impacto positivo para as gerações futuras.

description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role:

Are you passionate about connecting great talent with the right opportunities and eager to grow your career in Talent Acquisition? We are looking for a Junior Talent Acquisition Analyst to join our People team and support full‑cycle recruitment for tech and business roles within our Global Growth Group.

As part of a global organization, you will collaborate with teams across different countries — contributing to a high‑impact, candidate‑focused recruitment experience.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage end‑to‑end recruitment processes, with a focus on tech roles, ensuring a smooth and candidate‑centered experience.
  • Conduct intake meetings with hiring managers to align expectations, define role requirements, and understand team context.
  • Craft and publish job descriptions using Greenhouse and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Screen resumes using keyword and competency criteria, identifying top talent efficiently.
  • Actively source candidates through hunting, Boolean strategies, networking, and market mapping.
  • Lead competency‑based and cultural‑fit interviews.
  • Coordinate and schedule technical interviews with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide structured, timely, and actionable feedback to candidates and hiring teams.
  • Manage offer processes, ensuring alignment between candidate needs and organizational guidelines.
  • Track recruitment pipelines, maintaining workflow quality, data accuracy, transparency, and clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to hiring managers, keeping them informed, aligned, and on track throughout the process.
  • Support continuous improvements by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, standards, and tools.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in recruitment, ideally with exposure to tech positions.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, high‑volume, or tech‑driven environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Excel for building reports and PowerPoint for presentations.
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS), ideally Greenhouse.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining process quality and a strong candidate experience.
  • A proactive, organized, and detail‑oriented approach, with willingness to learn and grow.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user‑centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision‑making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium‑to‑large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem‑solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high‑quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user‑centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

Demographic Brazil

ABInBev is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce and culture. We conduct confidential surveys to better understand & ensure we provide equal opportunity throughout our end-to-end recruitment process. Individuals seeking employment at ABInBev are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

When you apply to a job on this site, the personal information contained in your application will be collected by ABINBEV SERVICES LLC. Your personal information will be processed in accordance with the law for the purposes of managing ABINBEV’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes.

On a voluntarily basis and subject to receiving your express consent, you’ll be asked demographic questions about your ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation and ability status. We collect this information for the purposes of supporting a diverse and inclusive workforce - it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter and all information will be reviewed collectively rather than individually. We won’t sell or share this information with third parties, but please note that we use Greenhouse Software Inc to manage the recruitment and hiring process on our behalf.

Your personal information will be retained by us for 2 (two) years from collection. You have the right to request access to your personal information, to request that your personal information be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted at any time. You can do so by contacting if you are located outside Europe, and emailing if you are located in Europe. We expect that our procedures will deal fairly and promptly with your request. However, if you remain dissatisfied, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

title: KYC Analyst
description:
About Marex

Marex Group plc is a diversified global financial services platform, providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients in the energy, commodities and financial markets. It is listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market in April 2024. With more than 35 offices in Europe, the US and APAC, it has unique access across markets with a significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge among its teams and divisions gives customers a clear advantage, and its technology‑led service provides access to all major exchanges, order‑flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award‑winning data, insights and analytics.

For more information visit

Client Onboarding Department

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combating financial crime and terrorist financing.

Role Summary

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that appropriate CDD / KYC and AML checks are carried out on all new customers in accordance with local regulatory requirements and Group standards and procedures.
  • Ensure that appropriate client documentation is issued to all new customers and in accordance with local regulatory and any exchange requirements.
  • Ensure that appropriate customer categorisations are carried out in accordance with local regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure daily targets set by the Onboarding Manager are met.
  • Accurately update the customer pipeline on a daily basis (Neon Onboarding).
  • Ensure that client and static data is accurately input and maintained into the Client Data Base (PeopleSoft).
  • Ensure that complete records of all customer documentation are maintained.
  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress.
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening.
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews, projects or audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out.
  • Efficiently deal with general day‑to‑day ad‑hoc queries.
  • Work closely with the Financial Crime team.
  • Keep management timely informed of issues and developments.
  • Ensure compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements.
  • Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company‑determined parameters are complied with.
  • Demonstrate the highest level of standards of integrity and conduct and reflect Company Values.
  • Always comply with Marex’s Code of Conduct.
  • Fully understand and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility.
  • Report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/or your supervisor as required.
  • Escalate risk events immediately.
  • Provide input to risk management processes, as required.

Skills And Experience

  • Experience in client onboarding, KYC and risk assessment of clients.
  • Solid understanding of client categorisation.
  • Worked in support of trading desks.
  • Analytical skills.
  • Problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

Competencies

  • A collaborative team player, approachable, self‑efficient and influences a positive work environment.
  • Demonstrates curiosity.
  • Resilient in a challenging, fast‑paced environment.
  • Ability to work within a fast‑paced and high‑volume environment.
  • Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others.
  • Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness.

Conduct Rules

  • Act with integrity.
  • Act with due skill, care and diligence.
  • Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators.
  • Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly.
  • Observe proper standard of market conduct.
  • Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Company Values

Acting as a role model for the values of the Company:

  • Respect – Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.
  • Integrity – Doing business the right way is the only way. We hold ourselves to a high ethical standard in everything we do – our clients expect this and we demand it of ourselves.
  • Collaborative – We work in teams – open and direct communication and the willingness to work hard and collaboratively are the basis for effective teamwork. Working well with others is necessary for us to succeed at what we do.
  • Developing our People – Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.
  • Adaptable and Nimble – Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non‑bureaucratic, but well‑controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.
  • Marex is fully committed to the elimination of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company.

Seniority level

  • Entry level

Employment type

  • Full‑time

Job function

  • Finance and Sales

Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Os projetos de eficiência energética realizam ações em comunidades baixa renda, além de beneficiar clientes residenciais com redução da conta de energia, através do uso seguro e mais eficiente da energia elétrica. About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the NYSE (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Team

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers. The position holder will be part of the Model Risk team within the Risk Management structure at Nubank. The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world‑class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. We act by providing independent review & challenge to models, staying tuned to cutting‑edge techniques, along with business and customers needs. We also work to identify and control risks related to our models and define and implement feedback loops to constantly improve them.

About The Role

  • Provide effective challenges, identify risks and enhancement opportunities, and engage with other Data Scientists and Business Analysts to strengthen our decision‑making tools;
  • Discuss and report model risk status and independent opinions on models with different stakeholders, including senior managers and regulators;
  • Contribute to the consolidation of and improve Nubank’s Model Risk Management and Model Review frameworks with autonomy and creativity;
  • Be exposed to different types of decisions and processes (e.g., credit, fraud, operations and in different countries).
  • Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on statistical, machine learning and AI techniques, with a stronger focus on credit models;
  • Develop playbooks and toolkits (Python, Scala, SQL, etc.) to optimize model reviews, ongoing models monitoring, and assess the impact of models in decisions;
  • Ensure the team maintains a high level of technical excellence.

We Are Looking For a Person Who Has

  • Great communication skills: clear, concise and structured.
  • Problem‑solving skills: strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities are essential for identifying risk factors and implementing effective risk management strategies.
  • Experience developing or validating machine learning models used to leverage important decision‑making processes or to solve relevant academic problems.
  • Interest in reviewing complex machine learning and other types of models to identify risks and propose enhancements.
  • Ability to work autonomously and demonstrate a sense of prioritization.
  • Data Science skills, strong knowledge of machine learning tools and techniques.
  • Strong programming skills, desirable previous experience with Python, SQL, GitHub.
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across levels.
  • Organized and detail‑oriented, without losing track of the big picture.
  • Advanced English skills.
  • Previous experience in credit risk management and/or other risk management frameworks would be a plus.
  • Master’s degree or relevant undergraduate scientific project would be a plus.
  • Previous knowledge of expected loss provisions modeling would be a plus.

  • Manter comunicação constante com as operações do cliente para alinhar intervenções e minimizar impactos nas áreas ocupadas.

Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de projetos HVAC e sistemas de utilidades.

Somos uma empresa de cibersegurança orientada a viabilizar as estratégias de negócios dos nossos clientes através de soluções seguras, flexíveis e inovadoras.

  • Monitorar o progresso das vendas e garantir o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.

Job description

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união, tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem‑estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso à saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

Enfermeiro (a) Pleno - Unidade Neurológica / Hospital Vera Cruz

Join to apply for the Enfermeiro (a) Pleno - Unidade Neurológica / Hospital Vera Cruz role at Hospital Vera Cruz

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care. A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

  • Realizar treinamentos/acompanhamentos dos liderados;
  • Realizar feedback dos colaboradores;
  • Realizar interface/integração com a equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Realizar planejamento da unidade com a gestão da agenda cirúrgica do dia e previsões de alta;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar as ações dos auxiliares de escritórios e auxiliares administrativos;
  • Realizar Interface/Integração com diversos departamentos para melhor funcionalidade do setor;
  • Acompanhar e monitorar a Adesão ADEP/Palm;
  • Realizar e acompanhar a passagem de plantão; devolução de material e medicamento e solicitações de OPME;
  • Acompanhar a Auditorias da Unidade: VISA, CCIH; Auditoria de Acreditações, Fiscalização COREN, entre outros;
  • Solucionar ouvidorias e conflitos do plantão;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de POP’s, Rotinas e PMI das Unidades;
  • Garantir o registro adequado do cuidado no Prontuário Eletrônico;
  • Garantir a aplicação das 6 metas Internacionais de Segurança;
  • Realizar SAE e prescrever plano de cuidados;
  • Aplicar escalas de complexidade de acordo com o perfil e avaliação dos riscos assistenciais;
  • Demais atividades pertinentes ao Enfermeiro.

  • Graduação completa em Enfermagem;
  • COREN ativo;
  • Experiência em Unidade de Terapia Intensiva;
  • Experiência em liderança de técnicos e distribuição de atividades conforme complexidade;

description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Clients are at the heart of our business, with superior execution and superb client service the foundation of the firm. We respect our clients and always treat them fairly.

Collaborative

Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Adaptable and Nimble

Our size and flexibility is an advantage. We are big enough to support our client’s various needs, and adaptable and nimble enough to respond quickly to changing conditions or requirements. A non‑bureaucratic, but well controlled environment fosters initiative as well as employee satisfaction.

description:
Overview

Fazemos parte do Grupo BTG Pactual, maior banco de investimento da américa latina. Nosso propósito é transformar ativos desvalorizados no mercado de crédito e real estate. Atuamos na gestão de créditos inadimplentes corporativos, ajudando fundos, investidores, instituições financeiras e empresas a encontrarem soluções estratégicas para seus negócios. Isso é possível, devido às nossas 4 verticais: Créditos Inadimplidos Coorporativos (NPL), Ativos Imobiliários Estressados (DRE), Recuperação Judicial e Falência e Dívida Ativa.

Principais destaques

Alguns dos nossos destaques:

  • Somos um dos maiores resultados do Grupo BTG Pactual.
  • Crescemos, em média, 20% ao ano.
  • Contamos com a ATENA, nossa IA que otimiza a rotina e potencializa análises.

Nossa comunidade é formada por 300 colaboradores e 170 parceiros, que atuam com proatividade, inovação, excelência, senso de dono e foco no cliente. Em um ambiente que valoriza o empreendedorismo, a meritocracia e o foco no cliente, promovemos uma cultura de resultados e crescimento profissional contínuo.

Utilizamos banco de dados PostgreSQL e com micro serviços desenvolvidos em Python (flask) e frontend em Angular. Toda nossa estrutura é “dockerizada” rodando em kubernetes e integrada utilizando tópicos (SNS) e filas (SQS). Também fazemos uso do Elasticsearch para otimizar nossas consultas. Tudo sendo provido pela AWS. Também temos toda uma esteira de CI/CD com testes automatizados provido pela Microsoft Azure Devops.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços em Python (Flask ou FastAPI), garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade;
  • Contribuir para a arquitetura técnica e para o desenho de soluções que traduzam demandas de negócio em sistemas robustos e eficientes;
  • Implantar integrações e automações utilizando o ecossistema AWS (EventBridge, SQS, RDS, Lambda, S3, entre outros);
  • Atuar na observabilidade e sustentação de aplicações em ambiente Kubernetes, com foco em confiabilidade e resiliência;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, dados e negócios) para evoluir continuamente a plataforma tecnológica da Enforce;
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e estratégicas de arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos

  • +8 anos de experiência em engenharia de software, utilizamos Python e frameworks modernos (Flask, FastAPI ou similares) mas caso você venha do Java e tenha desejo de trabalhar com nossa stack não será problema;
  • Vivência em ambientes baseados em microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS (preferencialmente EventBridge, SQS, Lambda, RDS e S3);
  • Conhecimentos em orquestração de containers com Kubernetes;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de alta qualidade;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com iniciativa e foco em resultados.

Aqui, o aprendizado é constante: a cada novo ativo adquirido, você estará imerso em um processo dinâmico de identificação de problemas e criação de estratégias eficazes. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de transformar mercados, impulsionar grandes projetos e crescer profissionalmente em um ambiente enérgico e colaborativo.

description:
Senior Product Designer - Performance & Ongoing Operations

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you\'ll do:

  • Collaborate & Influence: Partner with engineering, product management, and commercial teams to define and execute a shared vision for our digital experience.
  • Lead UX Strategy: Own your squad’s product design roadmap , shaping customer journey maps, user flows, and service blueprints to guide impactful solutions.
  • Design & Deliver: Drive end-to-end design execution—from early discovery and prototyping to shipping products and iterating based on feedback.
  • Facilitate & Align: Lead workshops, discovery sessions, and critiques to bring stakeholders into the design process, aligning on challenges and opportunities.
  • Advocate for the User: Champion user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, balancing business goals with a great customer experience.

What you\'ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Graphic Design, Digital Design, Visual Design, Product Design, or Industrial Design.
  • Strong communicator & storyteller – You can articulate design decisions clearly, influence stakeholders, and present ideas effectively in English.
  • Proven experience shipping digital products – You’ve worked in cross-functional teams, using iterative processes with both qualitative and quantitative insights.
  • Systems thinker with a tactical mindset – You can zoom out to see the bigger picture but also execute with precision at a detailed level.
  • Experience with UX research & strategy – You proactively uncover problems worth solving and ensure the team stays focused on the right challenges.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects without missing a beat – You’re adaptable and can shift focus while maintaining high-quality work.
  • Have experience working with Design Systems.
  • Strong English required for this position.

Nice To Have:

  • Experience working with back o ffice tools
  • Experience with Data Visualization design

Please Be Prepared to:

  • Include your updated portfolio either as an attachment or as a link to an online version within your resume.
  • Prepare a presentation of a product design case and prototype to be shared during the interviews.
